raw: I remember a tipped-over compost pail with maggots underneath it. That was what disgusted me—the maggots, and then noticing the rotting peaches stuck to the rim. The peaches made the whole thing seem even worse. The lid was wedged against the fence, so it wasn’t covering any of it. It’s funny which details stay with you: I picture that lid against the fence, but then my attention goes straight back to what was underneath the pail. Just thinking about that makes me feel disgusted again.
